extracted.intended_audience: artists (established and emerging) applying to MacDowell artist residencies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for artists to determine whether their work fits MacDowell's listed disciplines and to find the relevant application deadlines and residency periods. Covers which subdisciplines are accepted within each broad discipline and affirms inclusivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: General eligibility and inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Artists working in various stages of their artistic practice may apply in the following disciplines: architecture, film/video, interdisciplinary arts, literature, music composition, theatre, and visual arts. If you do not see your specific subdiscipline represented below, do not think you are excluded. Please contact us with any questions. In all our operations, we aim to be inclusive, not exclusive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to both established and emerging artists; lack of an exact subdiscipline listing is not a disqualification—applicants are encouraged to contact MacDowell for clarification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Architecture
rubrics_metrics.description: This discipline encompasses structural and landscape architecture, and includes design or writing projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepts practitioners working on design projects or research/textual projects related to architecture; both structural and landscape architecture are explicitly included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Film/Video
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships extend to animators, documentary filmmakers, experimental filmmakers, feature filmmakers, and screenwriters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers a wide range of moving-image practices (animation, documentary, experimental, feature film) and includes writers of screenplays; applicants from any of these subdisciplines are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdisciplinary Arts
rubrics_metrics.description: This discipline encompasses performance art, sound art, movement, choreography, new media and multimedia installation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for artists working across or between disciplines—performance-based practices, sound, movement/choreography, and new media installations are within scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literature
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers of novels, short stories, graphic writing, long-form journalism, essays, biographies, creative nonfiction, memoir, poetry, podcasts, and translations into English are accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Very broad literary remit including genre and form variants (fiction, nonfiction, poetry, translations, podcasts); applicants should consider whether their project fits one of the listed forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Music Composition
rubrics_metrics.description: All types of original composition in all musical styles are considered at MacDowell from hip-hop to classical and from post-modern jazz to electronica.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to composers in any style or genre; originality of composition is the focal point rather than specific instrumentation or tradition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theatre
rubrics_metrics.description: The theatre category includes playwrights, librettists, performance artists, and devised theatre artists, as well as composers of musical theatre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both text-based theatre creators (playwrights, librettists) and collaborative/devised practices and performance artists; musical theatre composers are explicitly included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Arts
rubrics_metrics.description: Makers of three-dimensional and two-dimensional art are considered from photographers and printmakers to sculptors and creators of large-scale installation as well as everything in between.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encompasses a wide range of media and scales, from photography and printmaking to large installations and sculpture; both two- and three-dimensional practices are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadlines and residency periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Application windows and residency dates are specified for seasonal cycles. Example: Spring/Summer 2027 — Deadline Sep 10, 2026; Residencies Mar 1–Aug 31, 2027; Accepting Applications Aug 15–Sep 10, 2026. Fall/Winter 2027–2028 — Deadline Feb 10, 2027; Residencies Sep 1, 2027–Feb 29, 2028; Accepting Applications Jan 15–Feb 10, 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must apply within the posted accepting-applications windows and by the stated deadlines to be considered for the corresponding residency periods; check the site for seasonal cycles and exact dates.
